players.product: DRAM / HBM and NAND probe cards, test interface boards and test sockets

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: consolidated revenue and operating profit rose sharply in Q2 and H1 2026 versus 2025; the semiconductor test equipment segment (probe cards, interface boards, OLED testers) drove the gain

Half-year report: TSE supplies DRAM and Flash probe cards to Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, SK Hynix Dalian, Micron, CXMT, YMTC, GigaDevice, MXIC and Winbond, and supplies the probe cards required for HBM and normal DRAM mass production to HBM makers worldwide; DRAM and HBM probe cards grew notably. Major customers by product: probe cards - Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, Samsung Display, CXMT, Micron; interface boards - Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, AMD, SanDisk, Intel; test sockets - Samsung Electronics, Hana Micron, YMTC, AMD, SanDisk. One undisclosed customer group took 10.99% of H1 revenue
quarterly_data.figure: parent H1 sales: probe cards KRW 118,169M (47.9%; FY2025 KRW 143,423M), interface boards KRW 82,706M (33.5%), test sockets KRW 25,320M (10.3%), OLED testers KRW 20,232M (8.2%); semiconductor test equipment segment revenue KRW 245,281,882 thousand vs KRW 139,753,494 thousand, segment operating profit KRW 78,388,130 thousand vs KRW 20,655,062 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report order backlog at 06-30-2026 (orders received 01-01 to 06-30-2026): probe cards due by 12-31-2026, test sockets by 08-26-2026, OLED/LED testers by 01-05-2027
quarterly_data.figure: backlog KRW 131,912M in total: probe cards KRW 84,477M (1,183 units), interface boards KRW 16,970M, test sockets KRW 12,068M, OLED/LED testers KRW 18,396M; H1 orders received KRW 281,340M

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: memory makers are expanding capacity aggressively as NAND, HBM and DRAM all grow with AI infrastructure, and probe card makers are expanding capacity to supply on time; TSE's H1 capex rose and its outstanding capital-expenditure commitments nearly tripled; probe-card PCB subsidiary Tiger Elec ran at 85% utilisation in H1 versus 52% in 2025
quarterly_data.figure: H1 PP&E acquisitions KRW 46,109,459,748 vs KRW 23,008,976,667; capex commitments KRW 21,542,238 thousand vs KRW 7,825,634 thousand at end-2025; Tiger Elec utilisation 85% (2025: 52%)
